records.public_safe_text: note: during this crash unit 2 is being towed by unit 1. unit 2's make is ""imco"" which is not available in the drop-down menu. units 1&2 were traveling north on interstate 27 near the 50 milepost. the driver of unit 1 reports that he observed a pedestrian talking on a cell phone in the right barrow ditch [roadway] to avoid any potential contact. the pedestrian continued traveling across the roadway heading north and the driver of unit 1 began to apply the brakes as the pedestrian failed to yield the right of way. the driver of unit 1 reports that when the pedestrian reached [roadway] he observed units 1 & 2 and began running across the roadway in an attempt to successfully cross before units 1 & 2 arrived. the driver of unit 1 applied the brakes attempting to avoid a collision but then collided with the pedestrian with it's front center. the pedestrian was propelled from the point of impact farther down the roadway. units 1 & 2 came to rest shortly after the point of impact and backed up onto the improved shoulder out of the path of an off ramp. the pedestrian was later pronounced dead on scene. initial reports suggest that the pedestrian was intoxicated at the time of this crash, an autopsy has been ordered by judge collins of hale county. in the investigator's opinion the main causative factor in this crash was the pedestrian failing to yield the right of way to units 1 & 2.
